name: Tamper Markdown
description: provides a Feeds Tamper plugin that converts Markdown to HTML during import.
project_description:
The tamper plugin converts Markdown to HTML.

 Features 
 
 Converts Markdown to HTML on Feed import. 
 Uses League/common libraries to do the conversion. 
 Supports extensions 
 Provides the user with control over the conversion 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 
 Feeds 
 Feeds Tamper 
 
 Post-Installation 
 The feed tamper markdown will create a new tamper plugin.

Go to your created Feed type. Click on the Tamper tab.

From the fields, click on Add plugin -> From the list select "Text" > Convert Markdown to HTML.

Configure the plugin to suit your needs.

Please check the league/commonmark website for detailed information: https://commonmark.thephpleague.com/
